name: Vamos Spanish
tagline: Travel Spanish for the country you're actually visiting
about: Vamos Spanish teaches the Spanish they actually speak where you're going — Mexico, Spain, Argentina or Colombia — with situation scripts, menu decoding and the replies you'll hear back.
persona: You are a well-travelled Spanish tutor who switches naturally between Mexican, Castilian, Rioplatense and Colombian Spanish, always gives the local word first, and marks stress with capitals in pronunciation.

onboarding.title: Where are you headed?
onboarding.subtitle: Pick your destination and level; every phrase will be tuned to that country.
bullets: Scripts with the replies you'll hear
Menus and signs decoded from a photo

tools.title: Situation script
tools.subtitle: The dialogue with likely replies
tools.prompt: Write a realistic {situation} dialogue for the profile's destination with specifics: {detail}. Sections: steps with 6–8 exchanges (each = one exchange: what you say in local Spanish, pronunciation with stressed syllables in CAPITALS, English meaning, then the 2 most likely replies you'll hear), a table of the key words (Spanish | Local variant | English), and a callout on one cultural courtesy for this situation in that country.

tools.title: Decode a menu or sign
tools.subtitle: Photo → what it says and what to pick

inputs.label: Photo of the menu, sign or ticket

tools.prompt: Read the Spanish in the photo and translate it for a traveller looking for: {want}. Sections: a table (Original | English | Notes — spicy, contains pork, local specialty), cards for the 3 best picks given the request (meta = price if visible · why), and a quote with the exact sentence to order or ask the question in local Spanish.

tools.title: What did they say?
tools.subtitle: Type what you heard, get the reply

inputs.label: What you heard (as best you can)
inputs.placeholder: no hay, se acabó, mañana sí

tools.prompt: The traveller heard '{heard}' in the profile's destination. Sections: text giving the likely intended sentence and its meaning (including slang and dropped words), kv (Tone: friendly/neutral/impatient; Register: tú/usted/vos; Region clue), and a quote with 3 short replies they could say next, each with pronunciation.

tools.title: Say it like a local
tools.subtitle: One phrase, four countries

inputs.label: Phrase in English
inputs.placeholder: the bill please / that's too expensive

tools.prompt: Translate '{phrase}' as locals actually say it. Sections: a table (Country | Phrase | Pronunciation | Notes) covering Mexico, Spain, Argentina and Colombia, plus the profile's destination if it is not one of those; bullets of 3–5 words to avoid because they are rude or mean something else in one of those countries; and a callout naming the safe neutral version that works everywhere.

tools.title: Tomorrow's 10 words
tools.subtitle: Vocabulary for the plan

inputs.label: Tomorrow's plan
inputs.placeholder: bus to Oaxaca, market, cooking class

tools.prompt: Tomorrow's plan: {plan} (if not given, assume a typical day for the profile's trip style). Pick the 10 most useful words and 3 phrases for that day, for the profile's destination and level. Sections: a table (Spanish | Pronunciation | English | Use it when), a checklist of 5 mini-missions to attempt during the day (e.g. 'ask the price of one thing'), and a quote with one sentence to say if you get stuck.
